tasks.label: Build Heap Sort
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && if not exist "${workspaceFolder}\build" mkdir "${workspaceFolder}\build" && cl.exe /nologo /std:c++17 /EHsc /W4 /O2 "${workspaceFolder}\main.cpp" /Fe:"${workspaceFolder}\build\heap_sort.exe" /Fo:"${workspaceFolder}\build\main.obj"
